n01.roman: GTA 6 ki Vice City, asli Miami par based hai. Toh chalo: Miami vs Mumbai!

n02.roman: TomTom Index 2025: Mumbai mein 10 km, ausatan 28 minute 51 second.

n03.roman: Miami mein? Sirf 17 minute 45 second. Yaani Mumbai mein har 10 km par 11 minute zyada!

n04.roman: Twist: Miami, America ke top 5 sabse congested shehron mein hai. Phir bhi Mumbai usse kaafi dheema!

n05.roman: Rush hour ki ausat speed? Mumbai: sirf 17.6 km/h. Miami: 27.4 km/h!

n06.roman: Aur rush hour ke traffic mein, Mumbai ka driver saal mein 126 ghante khota hai: 5 din se zyada!

n07.roman: Toh GTA 6 ka traffic? Asli boss level toh Mumbai hai!
